bondCurrencyCandidates.label: Circle Sepolia USDC (OOV3 defaultCurrency)
bondCurrencyCandidates.acquisition: Circle's public testnet faucet (manual, per-address rate limits). No mint function.
bondCurrencyCandidates.caveat: OOV3 caches finalFee=200 USDC (minimum bond 400 USDC) while the UMA Store now reports 0. Anyone may call OOV3.syncUmaParams(ASSERT_TRUTH, USDC) to refresh the cache; that is a public Sepolia transaction and needs explicit authorization.

bondCurrencyCandidates.label: Stackup '6TEST' test token (UMA-whitelisted on Sepolia)
bondCurrencyCandidates.acquisition: Verified source (Sourcify match) exposes public mint(to, amount) with amount < 1e18.
bondCurrencyCandidates.caveat: Third-party test token; minting is a public Sepolia transaction from the user's own test account.

rejectedCurrencies.reason: Verified MockERC20 exposes public burn(from, amount): anyone could destroy escrowed bonds.
WETH: our policy bond = max(minBond, 1 whole token) = 1 WETH, impractical from Sepolia faucets.

selectionNote: Frozen 2026-10-02: the default currency (Circle Sepolia USDC) is impractical to obtain because OOV3's cached final fee makes the minimum bond 400 USDC (faucet gives ~10-20/request) and lowering it needs a shared-state syncUmaParams transaction. 6TEST is UMA-whitelisted on Sepolia (CollateralWhitelist.isOnWhitelist == true, verified by npm run preflight:sepolia), 6 decimals, minimum bond 0 -> policy bond 1 6TEST, and its verified source (Sourcify match) exposes a public mint. Switch back to USDC only with an explicit decision (then run ACTION=sync-uma-params and obtain USDC from Circle's faucet). The value is re-read live at every assertion; maxBond protects proposers.
